description_en: Cancels the License authorization for a specified product
description_zh: 调用该接口取消指定产品的License授权
name: UnbindLicenseProduct

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Enterprise instance. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console
parameters.help_zh: 企业版实例的实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The License type (audio and video specification). Valid values: 480P and 720P.

You can view the License type of the target product on the License Management > Product Authorization page in the Audio and Video Communication Service console
parameters.help_zh:
License类型（音视频规格），可取值：480P、720P。

您可在音视频通信服务控制台的License管理>产品授权页面，查看目标产品的License类型
parameters.name: license_code

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product for which you want to cancel the authorization.

You can view the Product Key of the target product on the License Management > Product Authorization page in the Audio and Video Communication Service console
parameters.help_zh:
待取消授权的产品的ProductKey。

您可在音视频通信服务控制台的License管理>产品授权页面，查看目标产品的Product Key
parameters.name: product_key

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see the Error codes section in this topic
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见本文下方的错误码

Data.description_en:
Indicates whether the License authorization for the product is canceled.

true: The License authorization for the product is canceled.
false: The License authorization for the product failed to be canceled
Data.description_zh:
表示取消产品授权License是否成功。

true：取消产品授权License成功。
false：取消产品授权License失败

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful.
true: The call is successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
表示是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
